feature_name: Site SEO and retired merch cleanup
scope_summary: Clean up public website SEO so the sitemap lists only current active pages, retired local merch/shop/store pages are removed or marked gone, and Dopamine Depot links clearly disclose that they open the Printful store off-site.

legal_and_regulatory.rationale: The change removes stale local commerce surfaces and adds clearer off-site disclosure for the remaining Printful store link.
evidence: Removed local Dopamine Depot, shop, and store pages from the deploy surface
Visible Printful links now identify Printful and open in a new tab

privacy_local_first_promise.rationale: No new tracking or data collection was added, and external Printful links use noreferrer to avoid sending the page referrer.
evidence: Retired merch routes return 410 instead of silently redirecting visitors off-site

medical_scope_and_claims.rationale: No medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment claims were added in this SEO and routing cleanup.
evidence: Changes are limited to routing, sitemap, SEO metadata, and retired merch files

behavioral_science_alignment.rationale: No behavioral design feature was changed.

neurodivergence_research_alignment.rationale: No neurodivergence research guidance was changed.

user_benefit_and_harm_check.rationale: Users and crawlers get clearer current paths, fewer stale pages, and explicit notice before leaving Divergify for the Printful store.
evidence: Updated sitemap.xml to current active pages only
Old local merch/shop/store routes now return 410 Gone

brand_voice_and_claims.rationale: Branding remains consistent while removing confusing stale merchandise content and clarifying the current Printful relationship.
evidence: Dopamine Depot visible links now read as Printful links
Homepage metadata now describes a clearly disclosed Printful merch link

accessibility_and_inclusion.rationale: External store links include accessible labels that tell screen-reader users the link opens Printful in a new tab.
evidence: Printful links include aria-label text with the off-site/new-tab behavior

security_and_reliability.rationale: The cleanup removes unused build-time Printful fetching and reduces the number of stale public files that could be served accidentally.
evidence: Netlify build no longer runs the retired Printful catalog fetch
Deleted retired local shop files and their CSS/API script

monetization_and_dark_pattern_check.rationale: The only remaining merch path is an explicit opt-in external Printful link, with no hidden redirects, countdowns, or duplicate checkout paths.
evidence: Removed old local shop and Stripe checkout-link files
Retired merch URLs return 410 rather than sending users to a store without a fresh click

ship_decision.conditions: Deploy, then verify old merch URLs return 410 and submit the updated sitemap in search tools if stale URLs remain indexed.
